keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Thomas Kristensen (Atalanta).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Atalanta. Giorgio Scalvini replaces Thomas Kristensen because of an injury.
Delay in match (Fiorentina).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Eljif Elmas (Atalanta) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Viery (Fiorentina) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Fiorentina 0, Atalanta 1. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Nicola Zalewski.
First Half ends, Fiorentina 0, Atalanta 1.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Christ Inao Oulaï replaces Nicolò Fagioli.
Mateo Pellegrino (Fiorentina) is shown the yellow card for handball.
Goal! Fiorentina 1, Atalanta 1. Alieu Njie (Fiorentina) header from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Álex Jiménez with a cross.
Substitution, Atalanta. Mario Pasalic replaces Gianluca Gaetano.
Substitution, Atalanta. Jonathan Rowe replaces Eljif Elmas.
Goal! Fiorentina 2, Atalanta 1. João Mário (Fiorentina) right footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Alieu Njie.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Wilfried Gnonto replaces Alieu Njie.
Goal! Fiorentina 2, Atalanta 2. Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Charles De Ketelaere.
Wilfried Gnonto (Fiorentina) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Relja Obric (Atalanta) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Atalanta. Kamaldeen Sulemana replaces Nicola Zalewski.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Pote replaces Franco Mastantuono.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Beto replaces Mateo Pellegrino.
Second Half ends, Fiorentina 2, Atalanta 2.
